tools.name: leaddesk_find_leads
tools.title: Find leads
tools.description: Returns LeadDesk leads filtered by status, newest first. Read-only. The response never includes the lead's name, email, or message text — only company, status, source, budget, and createdAt.

status.description: Which status to search for among new, contacted, qualified, won, lost; any — every status

limit.description: How many leads to return, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 10

tools.name: leaddesk_set_lead_status
tools.title: Set lead status
tools.description: Changes a LeadDesk lead's status and adds an audit entry. This changes process data: before calling, make sure a human has confirmed this exact status change for this exact lead.

leadId.description: Lead identifier in the lead_0001 format, e.g. lead_0002

status.description: New status: new, contacted, qualified, won, or lost

reason.description: Why the status is changing, 3–500 characters
